name: @clarity/auth-service
description: Authentication service (ADR-0011). Session issuance/verification/revocation over the existing User/roles model: opaque bearer tokens stored only as SHA-256 hashes, server-side sessions with expiry and audited revocation, and the AuthenticatedPrincipal -> CommandActor bridge that sources roles from the database instead of the caller. Identity verification is behind the IdentityProvider port — a managed IdP (OIDC) adapter implements it at deployment; the local dev provider maps pre-registered synthetic assertions. No passwords are stored anywhere. No Prisma outside the approved gateway adapter.
